impact_potential_20pct.thesis: $1.4T of global manufacturing runs on legacy stripped PLC binaries whose source code is lost. When motors degrade (-58% torque) or heavy loads (500kg) are added, legacy PD controllers sag and drop assembly-line parts.
impact_potential_20pct.demo_proof: Live 3D Dual-Workcell Conveyor Arena showing Legacy Cell 01 sagging to 16.6° and dropping red crates into the reject chute while Evolved Cell 02 heals to 30.0° and passes 100% of crates.

technical_demo_35pct.thesis: Unified 3D Hardware-in-the-Loop Workbench with procedural 3D DIN-Rail PLC, 14 Tri-State 3D Bezier cables, Dual 3D Robot + Conveyor Workcells, Live PLC Disassembly & FFI Truth Table, and 1-Click Stage Director.
technical_demo_35pct.demo_proof: 4-Step 1-Click Stage Director + Auto-Pilot Demo with <16ms response and 100Hz WebSocket telemetry.

creativity_15pct.thesis: Combines binary reverse-engineering (x86-64 + ARM Cortex-M4 + EVM) with a 3D Tri-State Epistemic Wire Harness (UNKNOWN -> INFERRED -> SEEN) and self-healing Git evolution that automatically git-reverts overfit controllers.
creativity_15pct.demo_proof: Interactive 3D X-Ray Screw Terminal Inspector + v1 -> v2 (git revert on World 3 sensor lag) -> v3 (5/5 held-out worlds) saga.

implementation_difficulty_30pct.thesis: Probes 3 real compiled ELF binaries (stripped C servo plant, OpenPLC IEC 61131-3 runtime, STM32F407 ARM Cortex-M4 firmware in Unicorn VFPv4), runs 312 closed-loop physics episodes of (µ=4, λ=14) ES, verifies 262 Foundry Anvil EVM vectors, and kills 6 AST mutants in a Linux Landlock + seccomp sandbox.
implementation_difficulty_30pct.demo_proof: Live PLC Reverse Engineering Workbench + 24/24 pytest suite + 1,000/1,000 C FFI vectors + 262/262 Anvil EVM vectors.
